HDD Thread Grease

Designed for HDD auto-greasers

Copper and graphite-based oilfield grade grease ground to a finer particle size to suit HDD rig auto-greasers. Prevents galling and reduces wear in high-torque situations.

Copper-based

HDD KOPR

Premium Auto-Greaser Compound
A very finely ground copper-based grease designed to work well in auto-greasers. Specified to prevent galling and reduce wear in very high torque situations. The industry choice for serious HDD operations.
Auto-greaser compatible Anti-galling
Cost-effective

Thread Grease 21

Double-Duty Tool Joint Compound
A cost-effective option on rigs up to 40,000 lbs where an auto-greaser is not being used. A high-quality product for less severe applications that still protects against galling and high stress.
Manual application Up to 40,000 lbs

Oilfield & Valve Compounds

Premium drill collar & tool joint compounds

Copper-based and metal-free compounds for every drill string requirement — from standard tool joints to extreme environments and marine-pollutant regulated operations.

Premium Copper-Based

Industry standard

KOPR-KOTE®

Premium Drill Collar & Tool Joint Compound
Widely recognised as the best copper-based drilling compound in the world. Uniquely formulated to prevent excessive circumferential make up with a very high static friction factor. Prevents galling, seizure, and allows easy breakout.
-18°C to 450°F (232°C) DOT marine-pollutant exception
Mud-resistant

EXTREME®

Mud Resistant Drill Collar & Tool Joint Compound
Premium unleaded compound blended into Jet-Lube's high-temp, mud-resistant, complex-base grease. Offers extended storage capability. Prevents excessive circumferential make up by increasing the coefficient of friction.
-18°C to 450°F (232°C) DOT marine-pollutant exception
Double-duty

21®

Double-Duty Tool Joint & Drill Collar Compound
High-quality product designed for less severe applications than KOPR-KOTE. Formulated to prevent excessive circumferential make up of tool joints and protects against galling and high stress.
-18°C to 232°C standard NSF H2 Registered
Economical

JLS®

Tool Joint Compound
Economical compound containing premium-grade copper flakes, amorphous graphite, extreme-pressure additives, rust and corrosion inhibitors. Recommended for tool joints in medium-depth formations.
-18°C to 232°C Arctic: -55°C to 149°C

Premium Metal-Free

Non-metallic

NCS-30®

Tool Joint & Drill Collar Compound
Premium non-metallic compound containing carbon-based fibres, natural extreme-pressure and anti-wear additives. Superior adhesion to wet steel and resistance to water wash-off. Effective for invert or high-pH muds.
-29°C to 260°C NSF H2 Registered
ECF / Biodegradable

NCS-30® ECF

Tool Joint & Drill Collar Compound
Biodegradable, non-metallic formula meeting Norway “Yellow”, British and Dutch “E” HOCNF classifications. Non-conductive for MWD. Excellent for high-chrome or nickel-alloy connections.
-23°C to 260°C HOCNF compliant
Multi-functional

KOV'R-KOTE®

Double-Duty Tool Joint Compound / Sealant
Metal-free formula using polymers, graphite and friction-reducing additives. Ideal for drill collars, drill pipe, tubing, and bottom hole assemblies. Developed to replace compounds containing zinc, copper and heavy metals.
-18°C to 232°C standard Thermal: to 370°C
Eco-friendly

CURÄL™

Work Over / Non-Critical Tool Joint Compound
Non-metallic, environmentally acceptable compound for non-critical drilling, work over and production applications. Can also be used for lubricating, sealing and storage of drilling and production equipment.
-18°C to 232°C API-MODIFIED alternative

API Compounds

Zinc-based

Z-50™ & Z-60™

Zinc Tool Joint Compounds
Contain varying percentages of prime-grade metallic zinc dust with special additives. Ensure consistent floor make up, are brushable over a wide temperature range, adhere to all surfaces, resist water wash-off and prevent rust and corrosion.
-18°C to 149°C
API grade

API-MODIFIED

Thread Compound Sealant
High-pressure thread compound conforming to API Bulletin 5A2 and R.P. 5A3 requirements. Tenaciously adheres to wet or oily surfaces. Seals and withstands pressures to 10,000 psi on API connections. Will not harden or dry.
-18°C to 149°C Up to 10,000 PSI
OCTG Running Compounds

Casing, tubing & connection sealants

High-pressure sealant alternatives for API buttress, proprietary connections, and premium thread designs. Many meet ECF environmental classifications for offshore operations.

ECF / High-pressure

RUN-N-SEAL® ECF

Non-Premium Thread Connection Sealant
High-pressure sealant alternative for API Buttress and other larger clearance thread seal connection designs. Excellent water resistance — sticks to wet and oily steel, ensuring compound will not wash-off threads.
-18°C to 232°C Norway “Yellow” / “E” rated
Storage compound

RUN-N-SEAL® EXTREME

Running & Storage Compound
Non-metallic, high-pressure sealant for API connections (buttress and 8-round) and storage compound. Contains graphite and anti-wear additives blended into a state-of-the-art, rust-inhibiting complex soap-based grease.
-18°C to 232°C standard Non-toxic / Non-hazardous
Premium seal

SEAL-GUARD™ ECF

Yellow/“E”-Rated Premium Connection Compound
Specifically formulated for mechanical seal thread designs and high-alloy steel materials. Biodegradable, metal-free with frictional properties similar to API-MODIFIED.
-29°C to 260°C HOCNF compliant
Heavy wall

HPHT THREAD COMPOUND™

High Pressure / High-Temp Thread Compound
Specifically formulated for high performance, proprietary metal-to-metal seal and high interference connection designs. Utilises high-performance materials for “super chrome” and high-alloy steels.
Up to 232°C Eco-safe • Metal-free
Proprietary connection

SEAL-GUARD™

Proprietary Connection Thread Compound
Non-metallic thread compound providing optimum galling resistance and frictional properties in the make up of high-chrome, proprietary designs (metal to metal seals), and API 8-round designs.
-29°C to 260°C Friction factor 0.9 vs API-MODIFIED
All-weather

RUN-N-SEAL® EXTREME AWG

All Weather Grade, Metal-Free Thread Sealant
Metal-free, high-pressure sealant alternative versus API-MODIFIED for OCTG 8-round and buttress connections. Contains graphite and anti-wear additives. Non-toxic, H2S inhibited.
-40°C to 232°C H2S inhibited

Oilfield Specialty

Specialty grease, compounds & dope brushes

Extreme-service greases, threadlockers, wireline lubricants, storage compounds, and the brushes to apply them — all from the Jet Lube range.

Extreme service

ALCO-EP™ ECF

Extreme-Service Grease
Premium, biodegradable grease containing a synergistic blend of rust and oxidation inhibitors plus extreme pressure and anti-wear additives. Excellent for subsea and topside moving components. Approved for RC-4S and ALT-2 connections.
-29°C to 232°C Norway “Yellow” / “E” rated
Wireline

WIRE LINE LUBRICANT™ ECF

Slick / Electric Braided Wireline Lubricant
Unique product for wire line applications where a grease-type lubricant is required. Easy-flow formula sticks to the wire line and penetrates for added protection. H2S inhibited with anti-rust and anti-corrosion properties.
-29°C to 260°C H2S inhibited
Threadlocker

JET-LOK® III

High-Friction & Sealing Compound
Two-part zinc-free epoxy with non-metallic fillers. Permanently locks threaded connections under normal operating conditions. Recommended for casing, shoes, couplings, sub savers, towing eyes and collars.
Up to 204°C 68 ML & 255 ML kits
Storage protection

KORR-GUARD™

Storage Compound
Water-displacing, semi-fluid grease that flows into thread roots, displacing moisture, cutting oils and residual threading materials. Ideal for short or long-term storage of casing, tubing, drill pipe, or any threaded metal surface.
-29°C to 218°C Applied by brush — will not harden
Jacking system

JACKING SYSTEM GREASE™ ECF

Heavy-Load Equipment Grease
For jacking systems, slides, cantilever-type rigs and any heavily loaded gear equipment requiring extreme-pressure protection in demanding offshore environments.
